Why Choose Services Plus for a PSARA License in Telangana?

The private security industry in India has experienced sustained growth because residential complexes and IT parks and manufacturing units and hospitals and educational institutions and commercial establishments require additional security services. The Government of India established the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act 2005 (PSARA) to create regulations for the sector, which experiences dynamic growth. All private security agencies need to acquire a PSARA license from state authorities before they can start their security operations, according to the Act.

Security agencies in Telangana must obtain a PSARA license when they start their agency or expand their business operations according to legal requirements. The state government uses PSARA monitoring to safeguard its territory against unauthorized security agencies by verifying that only certified and trained agencies are permitted to operate.

The Home Department of the Telangana Government uses the PSARA license to permit individuals and partnership firms and LLPs and companies to operate private security agencies throughout Telangana.
The license ensures that the agency:
The agency must use security personnel who have completed training and been verified through proper background checks.
The agency must use security personnel who have completed training and been verified through proper background checks.
The agency needs to maintain complete records of all security personnel and all client information.
The agency needs to conduct its business activities according to ethical standards and responsible operational practices.
The PSARA Act makes running a security agency in Telangana without a legitimate PSARA license a criminal offense, which results in penalties for those who break this law.
The state of Telangana provides different PSARA licenses based on the size of your business and the areas that you operate in.
Single-District PSARA License
The security agency uses this license to conduct its business activities in one designated district of Telangana. It is suitable for small or newly established agencies.
Multi-District PSARA License
Agencies that want to work across multiple districts in Telangana need to obtain a multi-district PSARA license.
